posts.author: Colin Kaminski
posts.content_md:
This is a new forum section for beginning holographers. Ask questions here if you are looking for the most simple answer.

Note: If replies start to get complicated I will split the thread into the general holography section. *Please* keep replies to the most simple answer that a beginning holographer can use to get results. 

You may be able answer some of your question by looking at [http://www.holowiki.com/HoloWiki](http://www.holowiki.com/HoloWiki)

posts.author: Tom B.
posts.content_md:
Might also mention that there is a Beginners FAQ section in the HoloWiki [http://www.holographyforum.org/HoloWiki](http://www.holographyforum.org/HoloWiki)

It looks like it could use more content - maybe beginners could suggest what they'd like to see here.
